name: Student Start-up Loan
summary: A voluntary, tax-free loan for study costs. You repay it with indexation.
who: People getting Youth Allowance, Austudy or ABSTUDY Living Allowance.
key: $1,349, which you can borrow up to twice a year. Applications are open for the July to December 2026 period.
how: Apply through Services Australia while you are getting an eligible payment.
catches: You pay it back with indexation, so it can add up over time.
The page we checked gives no closing date. Check Services Australia.
